name: tashif.codes
description: Personal dashboard, blog, project directory and developer tools of Tashif Ahmad Khan. Tools register on document.modelContext in a live tab. They are not HTTP APIs.

tools.name: get_site_overview
tools.description: Overview of tashif.codes, Tashif Ahmad Khan, and the public sections of this site.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List public projects. Optional query filters by name, slug, language, or topic.

tools.name: search_projects
tools.description: Search projects and, when the dashboard is on screen, apply the same filter to the visible cards.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Get one project by name or slug.

tools.name: list_blog_posts
tools.description: List blog posts, newest first. Optional tag filter.

tools.name: get_blog_post
tools.description: Get one blog post by slug or title.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search project documentation titles and snippets.

tools.name: get_doc_page
tools.description: Get one docs page by project, slug, or title.

tools.name: list_docs
tools.description: List documentation trees on this site.

tools.name: get_resume
tools.description: Resume facts: experience, selected projects, education, skills. Not the PDF bytes.

tools.name: open_tab
tools.description: Open a dashboard section: projects, resume, blog, github, leetcode, or community.

tools.name: get_contact
tools.description: How to reach Tashif. Does not send mail.

tools.name: copy_email
tools.description: Copy me@taf.sh to the clipboard. Does not send mail.

tools.name: start_contact
tools.description: Draft a message to me@taf.sh. Fills the connect form when present, opens the visitor's mail app, and returns the full draft. Does not send until a human hits Send or the agent sends from the user's mailbox after they confirm.
